events.title: Patch 0.0.3 - Playtest Wrap-Up & Demo Announcement!
events.summary: Hey everyone! 👋A massive THANK YOU to all players who jumped into the mazes during our two-week Steam Playtest! Watching you navigate the traps and betray your friends gave us invaluable telemetry and helped us track down the last few stubborn edge-case bugs.Following these tests, we are rolling out Patch 0.0.3 (Demo Ready) to get the game in top shape. Best of all: the Official Public Demo will officially launch this Friday, September 4th, 2026!Here is the full changelog for this update:General

events.title: Patch 0.0.2 - Ready for Playtests !
events.summary: Hey everyone! 👋We’ve been working super hard behind the scenes to polish the game, smash bugs, and make sure running through these chaotic mazes feels as smooth and hilarious as possible. The game is getting closer to what we envisioned, and we’re genuinely thrilled to finally share this milestone with you!We’ve just deployed Patch 0.0.2, our final update before we officially open the doors to the Steam Playtest. events.summary: Hello everyone!We have some huge news to share today: the first official trailer for Get-Out-Hoomanz is finally live!We’ve poured our hearts into these visuals to give you a real taste of the world, the gameplay, and the atmosphere waiting for you.
